```{r import data}
# =========================
# IMPORT DATA
# =========================
measles_data <- read.csv(here("data/measles_data.csv")) %>%
  clean_names() %>%

  # -------------------------
  # REMOVE UNUSED COLUMNS
  # -------------------------
  dplyr::select(-c(1:2, 6, 7, 9, 10, 18:20, 23, 25, 30, 32, 38, 40, 41, 42,
            53, 58, 59, 69, 70, 73, 90, 98, 101:103)) %>%

  # -------------------------
  # CLEAN VARIABLES (ALL IN ONE MUTATE)
  # -------------------------
  mutate(
    # --- camp cleaning ---
    camp = case_when(
      camp == "other" ~ specify_other_camp,
      camp == "KTP Register Camp" ~ "Kutupalong RC",
      TRUE ~ str_replace(camp, "^camp_", "Camp ")
    ),

    # unify camp naming
    camp = case_when(
      camp %in% c("Camp 1", "Camp 8") ~ paste0(camp, "E"),
      TRUE ~ camp
    ),

    # --- block formatting ---
    block = block %>%
      str_remove("^block_") %>%
      str_to_sentence(),

    # --- date ---
    date_of_visit = as.Date(date_of_visit, "%m/%d/%Y"),

    # --- IPD / OPD classification ---
    ipd_opd = if_else(patient_id == "n/a", "OPD", "IPD")
  ) %>%

  # remove helper column AFTER use
  dplyr::select(-specify_other_camp)

# =========================
# SPATIAL DATA
# =========================
sub_blocks <- st_read(
  here("data/Block_Boundary_V1/Block_Boundary_V1.shp"),
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(CampName_1 = str_remove(CampName_1, " Extension$"))

# -------------------------
# MERGE CASES TO SHAPEFILE
# -------------------------
cases_sf <- measles_data %>%
  left_join(
    sub_blocks,
    by = c("camp" = "CampName_1",
           "block" = "BlockLabel")
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  filter(
    is.na(patient_id) |
      patient_id == "n/a" |
      !duplicated(patient_id)
  )

# -------------------------
# RANDOM POINT WITHIN BLOCK
# -------------------------
cases_points <- cases_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(District)) %>%
  mutate(
    geometry = map(geometry,
                   ~ st_sample(.x, 1) %>% st_cast("POINT"))
  ) %>%
  unnest(geometry) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_set_crs(st_crs(sub_blocks))

# -------------------------
# CAMP BOUNDARIES (AGGREGATED)
# -------------------------
camp_boundaries <- sub_blocks %>%
  group_by(CampName_1) %>%
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(geometry),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================
# EPICURVE BASE DATA
# =========================
epi_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(date_of_visit)) %>%
  arrange(date_of_visit) %>%
  group_by(date_of_visit) %>%
  mutate(
    case_id = row_number(),

    # tooltip for plots
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Sex: ", gender, "<br>",
      "Age: ", age_in_years, " years"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# =========================
# CALCULATE NUMBERS
# =========================

# Total
total_cases <- nrow(measles_data)

# IPD / OPD
severe_cases <- sum(measles_data$ipd_opd == "IPD", na.rm = TRUE)
simple_cases <- sum(measles_data$ipd_opd == "OPD", na.rm = TRUE)

# Last 7 days
weekly_cases <- sum(
  measles_data$date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

weekly_severe_cases <- sum(
  measles_data$date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7 &
  measles_data$ipd_opd == "IPD",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

weekly_simple_cases <- sum(
  measles_data$date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7 &
  measles_data$ipd_opd == "OPD",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Yesterday
yesterdays_cases <- sum(
  measles_data$date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

yesterdays_severe_cases <- sum(
  measles_data$date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1 &
  measles_data$ipd_opd == "IPD",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

yesterdays_simple_cases <- sum(
  measles_data$date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1 &
  measles_data$ipd_opd == "OPD",
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

```{r maps severity}
make_map <- function(group, color_var, label_exclude = NULL, title = NULL) {

  ggplot() +

    # -------------------------
    # SUB-BLOCK BACKGROUND
    # -------------------------
    geom_sf(
      data = sub_blocks %>%
        dplyr::filter(CampName_1 %in% group),
      fill = "white",
      color = "grey80",
      linewidth = 0.1
    ) +

    # -------------------------
    # CAMP BOUNDARIES
    # -------------------------
    geom_sf(
      data = camp_boundaries %>%
        dplyr::filter(CampName_1 %in% group),
      fill = NA,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    # -------------------------
    # CASE POINTS
    # -------------------------
    geom_sf(
      data = cases_points %>%
        dplyr::filter(camp %in% group),
      aes(color = {{ color_var }}),
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    # -------------------------
    # OPTIONAL LABELS (safe)
    # -------------------------
    geom_sf_text(
      data = camp_boundaries %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          CampName_1 %in% group,
          !CampName_1 %in% dplyr::coalesce(label_exclude, "")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(label = gsub("Camp ", "", CampName_1)),
      aes(label = label),
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    # -------------------------
    # LAYOUT + THEMES
    # -------------------------
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    labs(
  color = NULL,
  title = title
) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +

    theme_light() +

    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
}


# =========================
# MAPS — CLINICAL SEVERITY
# =========================

map_1 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_1, ipd_opd, "Kutupalong RC")
map_2 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_2, ipd_opd, "Nayapara RC")
map_3 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_3, ipd_opd, title = "Camp 22")
map_4 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_4, ipd_opd, title = "Camp 21")

```

```{r rendering inlet map}
#| title: "Clinical Severity"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0

# -------------------------
# APPLY FINAL STYLING (once)
# -------------------------
trim_map <- function(p) {
  p + theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )
}

maps <- list(
  m1 = trim_map(map_1),
  m2 = trim_map(map_2),
  m3 = trim_map(map_3),
  m4 = trim_map(map_4)
)

# -------------------------
# LEGEND
# -------------------------
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  maps$m1 +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 16)
    )
)

# -------------------------
# INSET FUNCTION
# -------------------------
add_inset <- function(main_map, inset_map, x, y, w, h) {
  cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(main_map, -0.1, 0, 1, 1) +
    cowplot::draw_plot(inset_map, x, y, w, h)
}

# Build inset compositions
map1_with_inset <- add_inset(maps$m1, maps$m3, 0.5, 0.02, 0.3, 0.3)
map2_with_inset <- add_inset(maps$m2, maps$m4, -0.2, -0.08, 0.5, 0.5)

# -------------------------
# COMBINE MAIN MAPS
# -------------------------
maps_combined <- (map1_with_inset | map2_with_inset) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(0.6, 0.4)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0))

# -------------------------
# DIVIDER LINE
# -------------------------
divider <- grid::linesGrob(
  x = grid::unit(c(0.5, 0.5), "npc"),
  y = grid::unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
  gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1)
)

maps_with_divider <- cowplot::ggdraw(maps_combined) +
  cowplot::draw_grob(divider)

# -------------------------
# FINAL PANEL
# -------------------------
final_map <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  maps_with_divider,
  legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.5, 0.08)
)

final_map
```

```{r second map}
#| title: "Treatment place"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0

build_map_panel <- function(map_1, map_2, map_3, map_4) {

  # -------------------------
  # TRIM MAPS
  # -------------------------
  trim_map <- function(p) {
    p + theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
      panel.border = element_blank()
    )
  }

  maps <- list(
    m1 = trim_map(map_1),
    m2 = trim_map(map_2),
    m3 = trim_map(map_3),
    m4 = trim_map(map_4)
  )

  # -------------------------
  # LEGEND
  # -------------------------
  legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
    maps$m1 +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 16)
      )
  )

  # -------------------------
  # INSET FUNCTION
  # -------------------------
  add_inset <- function(main_map, inset_map, x, y, w, h) {
    cowplot::ggdraw() +
      cowplot::draw_plot(main_map, -0.1, 0, 1, 1) +
      cowplot::draw_plot(inset_map, x, y, w, h)
  }

map1_with_inset <- add_inset(maps$m1, maps$m3, 0.5, 0.02, 0.3, 0.3)
map2_with_inset <- add_inset(maps$m2, maps$m4, -0.2, -0.08, 0.5, 0.5)

  # -------------------------
  # COMBINE
  # -------------------------
  maps_combined <- (map1_with_inset | map2_with_inset) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(0.6, 0.4)) &
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0))

  # -------------------------
  # DIVIDER
  # -------------------------
  divider <- grid::linesGrob(
    x = grid::unit(c(0.5, 0.5), "npc"),
    y = grid::unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
    gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1)
  )

  maps_with_divider <- cowplot::ggdraw(maps_combined) +
    cowplot::draw_grob(divider)

  # -------------------------
  # FINAL OUTPUT
  # -------------------------
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    maps_with_divider,
    legend,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.5, 0.08)
  )
}
# -------------------------
# CREATE MAPS (PHC)
# -------------------------
map_1 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_1, phc, "Kutupalong RC")
map_2 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_2, phc, "Nayapara RC")
map_3 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_3, phc, title = "Camp 22")
map_4 <- make_map(camp_groups$group_4, phc, title = "Camp 21")

# -------------------------
# RENDER PANEL
# -------------------------
build_map_panel(map_1, map_2, map_3, map_4)

```

### Row {height="81%"}

```{r values 4}
#| padding: 0px

# -------------------------
# PREP WEEKLY DATA
# -------------------------
epi_cases_weekly <- epi_cases %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    week_start = lubridate::floor_date(date_of_visit, "week", week_start = 7),
    week_label = paste0("Wk of ", format(week_start, "%d %b"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(week_start, week_label, ipd_opd) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cases   = dplyr::n(),
    min_age = min(age_in_years, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age = max(age_in_years, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hover_text = paste0(
      ipd_opd, ": ", cases,
      "<br>Age: ", min_age, "-", max_age, " yrs"
    )
  )

# -------------------------
# PLOT
# -------------------------
epi_curve <- ggplot(
  epi_cases_weekly,
  aes(
    x = factor(week_label, levels = unique(week_label)),
    y = cases,
    fill = ipd_opd,
    text = hover_text
  )
) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly aggregated cases (Sunday–Saturday)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cases",
    fill = "Clinical Severity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# -------------------------
# INTERACTIVE
# -------------------------
ggplotly(epi_curve, tooltip = "text") %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

# Indicators 
```{r indicators}
# =========================
# INDICATORS
# =========================

# -------------------------
# Surveillance period
# -------------------------
surv_start <- min(measles_data$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE)
surv_end   <- max(measles_data$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE)
surv_days  <- as.integer(difftime(surv_end, surv_start, units = "days")) + 1

# -------------------------
# Totals
# -------------------------
N_total <- nrow(measles_data)

N_cases_u5 <- sum(measles_data$age_in_years < 5, na.rm = TRUE)

# -------------------------
# Outcomes
# -------------------------
N_discharge <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "discharged", na.rm = TRUE)
N_LAMA      <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "lama", na.rm = TRUE)

pct_discharge <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(N_discharge / N_total * 100, 1), NA)
pct_LAMA      <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(N_LAMA / N_total * 100, 1), NA)

# -------------------------
# PHC origin
# -------------------------
N_JMS <- sum(measles_data$phc == "new_jms", na.rm = TRUE)
O_JMS <- sum(measles_data$phc == "old_jms", na.rm = TRUE)
N_HMS <- sum(measles_data$phc == "hms", na.rm = TRUE)

# -------------------------
# Population + attack rate
# -------------------------
pop_at_risk <- 184858

N_total_fdmn <- sum(measles_data$nationality == "fdmn", na.rm = TRUE)

attack_rate <- round(N_total_fdmn / pop_at_risk * 1000, 2)
incidence_rate <- round(N_total_fdmn / pop_at_risk * 10000 / surv_days, 3)

# -------------------------
# Severity
# -------------------------
N_severe <- sum(measles_data$clinical_severity == "severe", na.rm = TRUE)
severe_rate <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(N_severe / N_total * 100, 2), NA)

# -------------------------
# Deaths / CFR
# -------------------------
N_deaths <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "died", na.rm = TRUE)

cfr <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(N_deaths / N_total * 100, 2), NA)

deaths_u5 <- sum(
  measles_data$outcome == "died" &
  measles_data$age_in_years < 5,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cfr_u5 <- ifelse(N_cases_u5 > 0, round(deaths_u5 / N_cases_u5 * 100, 2), NA)

# -------------------------
# Vaccination
# -------------------------
N_vaccinated <- sum(
  measles_data$did_the_patient_receive_measle %in% c("yes", "Yes"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

vacc_coverage <- ifelse(N_total > 0,
                        round(N_vaccinated / N_total * 100, 1),
                        NA)

# -------------------------
# Nationality
# -------------------------
fdmn <- sum(measles_data$nationality == "fdmn", na.rm = TRUE)
host <- sum(measles_data$nationality == "host", na.rm = TRUE)

fdmn_pct <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(fdmn / N_total * 100, 2), NA)
host_pct <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(host / N_total * 100, 2), NA)

# -------------------------
# IPD subset
# -------------------------
ipd <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes")

# Pneumonia among IPD
pneumonia_ipd <- sum(ipd$pneumonia == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

pct_pneumonia_ipd <- ifelse(
  N_IPD > 0,
  round(pneumonia_ipd / N_IPD * 100, 1),
  NA
)

# -------------------------
# Complications (IPD)
# -------------------------
complications_ipd <- ipd %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("complications_")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ .x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true")
  ))

# -------------------------
complication_prop <- complications_ipd %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "complication",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `% of IPD` = ifelse(
      N_IPD > 0,
      round(n / N_IPD * 100, 2),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
 
  # Put all string manipulation AFTER numeric calculations
  dplyr::mutate(
    complication = stringr::str_remove(complication, "^complications_"),
    complication = stringr::str_replace_all(complication, "_", " "),
    complication = stringr::str_to_title(complication)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
# -------------------------
# Final proportions
# -------------------------
OPD_pct <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(N_OPD / N_total * 100, 2), NA)
IPD_pct <- ifelse(N_total > 0, round(N_IPD / N_total * 100, 2), NA)
```

```{r}
  ),

camp_population %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  # -------------------------
  # TITLE

  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Population at Risk by Camp / Location**")
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------
  # COLUMN LABELS
  # -------------------------
  gt::cols_label(
    `Camp / Location` = "Camp / Location",
    `Pop (At Risk)`   = "Population at Risk",
    `Under-5 Pop`     = "<5 Population",
    Source            = "Source",
    `Last Updated`    = "Last Updated"

  # -------------------------
  # FORMATTING
  # -------------------------
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(`Pop (At Risk)`, `Under-5 Pop`),
    decimals = 0,
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------
  # ALIGNMENT
  # -------------------------
  gt::cols_align(
```

```{r attack rate}
#| title: "Incidence"

# FDMN (Camps + Other Camps)
pop_fdmn_total <- 39144 + 66883 + 27147 + 1015397
pop_fdmn_u5    <- 6010  + 11051 + 4341  + 163456

# Host community
pop_host_total <- 541921
pop_host_u5    <- 86707

# Combined populations
pop_total    <- pop_fdmn_total + pop_host_total
pop_total_u5 <- pop_fdmn_u5 + pop_host_u5


# =========================
# PREP DATA
# =========================
inc_base <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    date_of_visit = as.Date(date_of_visit),
    month = lubridate::floor_date(date_of_visit, "month"),
    U5 = age_in_years < 5,
    FDMN = nationality == "fdmn"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(month))


# =========================
# MONTHLY ATTACK RATE
# =========================
inc_monthly <- inc_base %>%
  dplyr::group_by(month) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    # Case counts
    cases_fdmn_total = sum(FDMN, na.rm = TRUE),
    cases_total      = dplyr::n(),

    cases_fdmn_u5    = sum(FDMN & U5, na.rm = TRUE),
    cases_total_u5   = sum(U5, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    # Attack rates (/1000 population)
    inc_fdmn_total = (cases_fdmn_total / pop_fdmn_total) * 1000,
    inc_total      = (cases_total / pop_total) * 1000,

    inc_fdmn_u5    = (cases_fdmn_u5 / pop_fdmn_u5) * 1000,
    inc_total_u5   = (cases_total_u5 / pop_total_u5) * 1000
  )


# =========================
# OVERALL ATTACK RATE
# =========================
inc_total <- inc_base %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cases_fdmn_total = sum(FDMN, na.rm = TRUE),
    cases_total      = dplyr::n(),

    cases_fdmn_u5    = sum(FDMN & U5, na.rm = TRUE),
    cases_total_u5   = sum(U5, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    month = "Overall",

    inc_fdmn_total = (cases_fdmn_total / pop_fdmn_total) * 1000,
    inc_total      = (cases_total / pop_total) * 1000,

    inc_fdmn_u5    = (cases_fdmn_u5 / pop_fdmn_u5) * 1000,
    inc_total_u5   = (cases_total_u5 / pop_total_u5) * 1000
  )


# =========================
# MERGE MONTHLY + TOTAL
# =========================
inc_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  inc_monthly %>%
    dplyr::mutate(month = format(month, "%b %Y")),
  inc_total
)


# =========================
# RESHAPE FOR TABLE
# =========================
inc_long <- inc_all %>%
  dplyr::select(
    month,
    inc_fdmn_u5,
    inc_total_u5,
    inc_fdmn_total,
    inc_total
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -month,
    names_to = "Indicator",
    values_to = "Incidence"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Indicator = dplyr::case_when(
      Indicator == "inc_fdmn_u5"    ~ "U5 FDMN",
      Indicator == "inc_total_u5"   ~ "U5 Total",
      Indicator == "inc_fdmn_total" ~ "Total FDMN",
      Indicator == "inc_total"      ~ "Total Population"
    )
  )


# =========================
# FINAL TABLE
# =========================
inc_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = month,
    values_from = Incidence
  ) %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  # Title
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Attack Rate (/1,000 population)**")
  ) %>%

  # Alignment
  gt::cols_align("left", Indicator) %>%
  gt::cols_align("center", -Indicator) %>%

  # Formatting
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = -Indicator,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%

  gt::fmt_missing(everything(), missing_text = "") %>%

  # Font
  gt::opt_table_font(
    font = list(gt::google_font("Roboto"), gt::default_fonts())
  ) %>%

  # Styling
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  )

```

```{r second indicator table}
add_section <- function(title) {

# -------------------------

    NA,

    NA,

)

# -------------------------
```

```{r referral}
#| title: "Isolation"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0

# -------------------------
# IPD DATA
# -------------------------
ipd <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(ipd_opd == "IPD")

N_IPD <- nrow(ipd)

# -------------------------
# PARSE LENGTH OF STAY
# -------------------------
parse_los_minutes <- function(x) {
  hrs  <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+(?=\\s*hours?)"))
  mins <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+(?=\\s*minutes?)"))

  hrs[is.na(hrs)]  <- 0
  mins[is.na(mins)] <- 0

  hrs * 60 + mins
}

ipd <- ipd %>%
  dplyr::mutate(los_minutes = parse_los_minutes(los_final))

total_los_days <- sum(ipd$los_minutes, na.rm = TRUE) / 60 / 24
avg_los_days <- ifelse(N_IPD > 0, total_los_days / N_IPD, NA)

# -------------------------
# INDICATOR TABLE
# -------------------------
indicator_tbl <- tibble::tibble(

  Indicator = c(
    "Total admissions (IPD)",
    "— From referral (facility)",
    "— Own catchment",
    "% Children <5 years",
    "% Unvaccinated",
    "% With pneumonia (any)",
    "— Severe pneumonia",
    "— Simple pneumonia",
    "% With SAM or MAM",
    "— SAM only",
    "— MAM only",
    "% Vitamin A given (within 24h)"
  ),

  Numerator = c(
    N_IPD,

    sum(!is.na(ipd$referral_from) & !ipd$referral_from %in% c("n/a", "n_a", "")),

    sum(is.na(ipd$referral_from) | ipd$referral_from %in% c("n/a", "n_a", "")),

    sum(ipd$age_in_years < 5, na.rm = TRUE),

    sum(ipd$did_the_patient_receive_measle %in% c("no", "No"), na.rm = TRUE),

    # Pneumonia (any)
    sum(
      ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_pneumonia %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE") |
      ipd$final_diagnoses_simple_pneumonia %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Severe pneumonia
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_pneumonia %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE"), na.rm = TRUE),

    # Simple pneumonia
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_simple_pneumonia %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE"), na.rm = TRUE),

    # SAM or MAM
    sum(
      ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE") |
      ipd$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # SAM
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE"), na.rm = TRUE),

    # MAM
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE"), na.rm = TRUE),

    sum(ipd$did_the_patient_receive_vitamin_a %in% c("yes", "Yes"), na.rm = TRUE)
  ),

  Denominator = rep(N_IPD, 12)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Rate / %` = ifelse(
      Denominator > 0,
      round(Numerator / Denominator * 100, 1),
      NA
    )
  )

# -------------------------
# GT TABLE
# -------------------------
indicator_tbl %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Isolation Centre OJMS — IPD (Admitted Patients)**")
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_label(
    Indicator   = "Indicator (IPD only)",
    Numerator   = "Numerator",
    Denominator = "Total IPD",
    `Rate / %`  = "%"
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_align(align = "left", columns = Indicator) %>%
  gt::cols_align(align = "right", columns = -Indicator) %>%

  # Formatting
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(Numerator, Denominator), decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `Rate / %`, decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::fmt_missing(everything(), missing_text = "") %>%

  # Styling
  gt::opt_table_font(
    font = list(gt::google_font("Roboto"), gt::default_fonts())
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_align_table_header(align = "left") %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(gt::everything())
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "black"),
    locations = gt::cells_body()
  ) %>%

  # Indentation for sub-rows
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(indent = gt::px(15)),
    locations = gt::cells_body(rows = grepl("^—", Indicator))
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_width(
    Indicator ~ gt::px(360),
    everything() ~ gt::px(120)
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------
  # SOURCE NOTE (LOS)
  # -------------------------
  gt::tab_source_note(
    gt::md(
      paste0("**Average length of stay:** ",
             round(avg_los_days, 2),
             " days")
    )
  )
```

```{r second tab}
#| title: "Age groups"

# -------------------------
# PREP AGE DATA
# -------------------------
measles_data_age <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    age_in_months = as.integer(age_in_months),

    age_group = dplyr::case_when(
      age_in_years == 0 & age_in_months < 9  ~ "<9 months",
      age_in_years == 0 & age_in_months >= 9 ~ "9 months–4 years",
      age_in_years >= 1 & age_in_years < 5   ~ "9 months–4 years",
      age_in_years >= 5 & age_in_years < 15  ~ "5–14 years",
      age_in_years >= 15                     ~ "≥15 years",
      TRUE                                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# -------------------------
# TOTAL DISTRIBUTION
# -------------------------
age_prop <- measles_data_age %>%
  dplyr::count(age_group, name = "N_all")

# OPD / IPD split
age_prop_opd <- measles_data_age %>%
  dplyr::filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and %in% c("no", "n/a")) %>%
  dplyr::count(age_group, name = "OPD_N")

age_prop_ipd <- measles_data_age %>%
  dplyr::filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes") %>%
  dplyr::count(age_group, name = "IPD_N")

# -------------------------
# MERGE
# -------------------------
age_section <- age_prop %>%
  dplyr::left_join(age_prop_opd, by = "age_group") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(age_prop_ipd, by = "age_group") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(OPD_N, 0),
    IPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(IPD_N, 0),
    Denominator = N_total,
    `% Total` = round(N_all / N_total * 100, 2)
  )

# -------------------------
# UNDER 5 TOTAL
# -------------------------
under5_row <- age_section %>%
  dplyr::filter(age_group %in% c("<9 months", "9 months–4 years")) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    age_group   = "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
    N_all       = sum(N_all),
    OPD_N       = sum(OPD_N),
    IPD_N       = sum(IPD_N),
    Denominator = N_total,
    `% Total`   = round(N_all / N_total * 100, 2)
  )

# -------------------------
# SEVERE IPD
# -------------------------
severe_ipd <- measles_data_age %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes",
    clinical_severity == "severe"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(age_group, name = "Severe_IPD_N")

severe_under5 <- measles_data_age %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes",
    clinical_severity == "severe",
    age_group %in% c("<9 months", "9 months–4 years")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    age_group = "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
    Severe_IPD_N = dplyr::n()
  )

severe_ipd_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(severe_ipd, severe_under5)

# -------------------------
# FINAL TABLE DATA
# -------------------------
age_levels <- c(
  "<9 months",
  "9 months–4 years",
  "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
  "5–14 years",
  "≥15 years"
)

age_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(age_section, under5_row) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(severe_ipd_final, by = "age_group") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Severe_IPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(Severe_IPD_N, 0),
    `% of IPD` = ifelse(N_IPD > 0, round(IPD_N / N_IPD * 100, 2), NA),
    `Severe %` = ifelse(IPD_N > 0,
                        round(Severe_IPD_N / IPD_N * 100, 2),
                        NA),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(age_group)

# -------------------------
# GT TABLE
# -------------------------
age_final %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**% of age groups (OPD and IPD)**")
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_label(
    age_group    = "Age Group",
    N_all        = "N (All)",
    Denominator  = "Denominator",
    `% Total`    = "% Total",
    OPD_N        = "OPD (N)",
    IPD_N        = "N",
    `% of IPD`   = "%",
    Severe_IPD_N = "Severe N",
    `Severe %`   = "Severe %"
  ) %>%

  # Spanners
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "TOTAL",
    columns = c(N_all, Denominator, `% Total`, OPD_N)
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "IPD",
    columns = c(IPD_N, `% of IPD`, Severe_IPD_N, `Severe %`)
  ) %>%

  # Alignment
  gt::cols_align("center", -age_group) %>%
  gt::cols_align("left", age_group) %>%

  # Style
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_spanners()
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#F8F9FA")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      rows = age_group == "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)"
    )
  ) %>%

  gt::opt_table_font(
    font = list(gt::google_font("Roboto"), gt::default_fonts())
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_width(
    age_group ~ gt::px(230),
    everything() ~ gt::px(110)
  )
```

```{r referal from }
#| title: "Referrals"

# -----------------------------------------------------
# REFERRALS (IPD ONLY)

# -------------------------
# REFERRAL FROM (sources)
# -------------------------
referral_map <- c(
  ocp_goyalmara  = "OCP Goyalmara",
  ocp_hoh        = "OCP HoH",
  other_facility = "Other facility",
  brac           = "BRAC",
  iom            = "IOM",
  oca_ktp        = "OCA KTP",
  "n/a"          = "NJMS/HMS",
  "n_a"          = "NJMS/HMS"
)

referral_levels <- c(
  "OCP Goyalmara",
  "OCP HoH",
  "Other facility",
  "BRAC",
  "IOM",
  "OCA KTP",
  "NJMS/HMS"
)

referral_ipd <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    referral_from = tolower(trimws(referral_from)),
    Referral_Source = referral_map[referral_from]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Referral_Source)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Referral_Source, name = "N_IPD") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Referral_Source = referral_levels,
    fill = list(N_IPD = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Denominator = sum(N_IPD),
    `% of IPD` = ifelse(
      Denominator > 0,
      round(N_IPD / Denominator * 100, 2),
      NA
    ),
    Referral_Source = factor(Referral_Source, levels = referral_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Referral_Source)

# -------------------------
# REFERRALS TO (outgoing)
# -------------------------
referral_to_ipd <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    referred_to = tolower(trimws(if_referred_where))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Referred_To = dplyr::case_when(
      referred_to == "oca_ktp"       ~ "OCA KTP",
      referred_to == "ocp_goyalmara" ~ "OCP Goyalmara",
      TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Referred_To)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Referred_To, name = "N") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Denominator = N_IPD,
    `% of IPD` = ifelse(
      N_IPD > 0,
      round(N / N_IPD * 100, 2),
      NA
    )
  )

# Total referred out
total_referred_out <- referral_to_ipd %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Referred_To = "Total referred out (any facility)",
    N = sum(N),
    Denominator = N_IPD,
    `% of IPD` = ifelse(N_IPD > 0, round(N / N_IPD * 100, 2), NA)
  )

referral_to_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(referral_to_ipd, total_referred_out)

# -------------------------
# COMBINE TABLE
# -------------------------
from_header <- tibble::tibble(
  Referral_Source = "REFERRALS FROM",
  N_IPD = NA_real_,
  Denominator = NA_real_,
  `% of IPD` = NA_real_
)

to_header <- tibble::tibble(
  Referral_Source = "REFERRALS TO",
  N_IPD = NA_real_,
  Denominator = NA_real_,
  `% of IPD` = NA_real_
)

referral_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  from_header,
  referral_ipd %>% dplyr::select(Referral_Source, N_IPD, Denominator, `% of IPD`),
  to_header,
  referral_to_final %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Referral_Source = Referred_To,
      N_IPD = N,
      Denominator,
      `% of IPD`
    )
)

# -------------------------
# GT TABLE
# -------------------------
referral_combined %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Referrals IPD**")
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_label(
    Referral_Source = "Referral Source",
    N_IPD           = "N referred",
    Denominator     = "Total IPD",
    `% of IPD`      = "% referred"
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_align("center", c(N_IPD, Denominator, `% of IPD`)) %>%
  gt::cols_align("left", Referral_Source) %>%

  # Formatting
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(N_IPD, Denominator), decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `% of IPD`, decimals = 1) %>%
  gt::fmt_missing(everything(), missing_text = "") %>%

  # Styling
  gt::opt_table_font(
    font = list(gt::google_font("Roboto"), gt::default_fonts())
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      rows = Referral_Source %in% c("REFERRALS FROM", "REFERRALS TO")
    )
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_width(
    Referral_Source ~ gt::px(260),
    everything() ~ gt::px(120)
  )
```

```{r third tab}
#| title: "Patient Origin"

# -------------------------
# STANDARDISE CAMP NAMES
# -------------------------
measles_camp <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Camp = dplyr::case_when(
      camp %in% c("14", "Camp 14") ~ "Camp 14",
      camp %in% c("15", "Camp 15") ~ "Camp 15",
      camp %in% c("16", "Camp 16") ~ "Camp 16",
      TRUE                         ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# -------------------------
# CASE COUNTS
# -------------------------
camp_cases <- measles_camp %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Camp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `ALL Cases` = dplyr::n(),
    IPD_N       = sum(ipd_opd == "IPD", na.rm = TRUE),
    Simple_N    = sum(clinical_severity == "simple", na.rm = TRUE),
    Severe_N    = sum(clinical_severity == "severe", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -------------------------
# POPULATION
# -------------------------
camp_population_clean <- camp_population %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Camp = dplyr::case_when(
      `Camp / Location` %in% c("Camp 14", "Camp 15", "Camp 16") ~ `Camp / Location`,
      TRUE                                                     ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Camp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Population = sum(`Pop (At Risk)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -------------------------
# FINAL TABLE
# -------------------------
camp_table <- camp_cases %>%
  dplyr::left_join(camp_population_clean, by = "Camp") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `% Total` = round(`ALL Cases` / sum(`ALL Cases`) * 100, 1),

    # ✅ SAFE attack rate (won’t crash if missing population)
    `Attack Rate /1k` = ifelse(
      !is.na(Population) & Population > 0,
      round((`ALL Cases` / Population) * 1000, 2),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    factor(Camp, levels = c("Camp 14", "Camp 15", "Camp 16", "Other"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Camp,
    `ALL Cases`,
    `% Total`,
    IPD_N,
    Simple_N,
    Severe_N,
    `Attack Rate /1k`
  )

# -------------------------
# GT TABLE
# -------------------------
camp_table %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Patients Origin by Camp**")
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_label(
    Camp              = "Camp / Location",
    `ALL Cases`       = "All Cases",
    `% Total`         = "% Total",
    IPD_N             = "IPD (N)",
    Simple_N          = "Simple (N)",
    Severe_N          = "Severe (N)",
    `Attack Rate /1k` = "Attack Rate /1k"
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_align("left", Camp) %>%
  gt::cols_align(
    "right",
    c(`ALL Cases`, `% Total`, IPD_N, Simple_N, Severe_N, `Attack Rate /1k`)
  ) %>%

  # Formatting
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(`ALL Cases`, IPD_N, Simple_N, Severe_N), decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `% Total`, decimals = 1) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `Attack Rate /1k`, decimals = 2) %>%
  gt::fmt_missing(everything(), missing_text = "") %>%

  # Styling
  gt::opt_table_font(
    font = list(gt::google_font("Roboto"), gt::default_fonts())
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_align_table_header(align = "left") %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "black"),
    locations = gt::cells_body()
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_width(
    Camp ~ gt::px(230),
    everything() ~ gt::px(120)
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "Co-diagnoses"

# --------------------------------------------------
# DENOMINATORS
# --------------------------------------------------
N_IPD <- sum(measles_data$ipd_opd == "IPD", na.rm = TRUE)
N_all <- nrow(measles_data)

# --------------------------------------------------
# LONG FORMAT (IPD ONLY)
# --------------------------------------------------
final_dx_long <- measles_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::starts_with("final_diagnoses_"),
    -dplyr::any_of("final_diagnoses_measles")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      everything(),
      ~ .x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true")
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to  = "Diagnosis",
    values_to = "Present"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Present)

# --------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY
# --------------------------------------------------
co_dx_final <- final_dx_long %>%
  dplyr::count(Diagnosis, name = "Numerator") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Denominator (IPD)` = N_IPD,
    `% of IPD` = round(Numerator / N_IPD * 100, 2),
    `% of All Cases` = round(Numerator / N_all * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
 
  # STRING MANIPULATION MUST BE SEPARATE
  dplyr::mutate(
    Diagnosis = stringr::str_remove(Diagnosis, "^final_diagnoses_"),
    Diagnosis = stringr::str_replace_all(Diagnosis, "_", " "),
    Diagnosis = paste0("+ ", stringr::str_to_title(Diagnosis))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Numerator))

# --------------------------------------------------
# GT TABLE
# --------------------------------------------------
co_dx_final %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Co‑Diagnoses (IPD Patients)**")
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_label(
    Diagnosis          = "Co‑Diagnosis",
    Numerator          = "N (IPD)",
    `Denominator (IPD)`= "Total IPD",
    `% of IPD`         = "% of IPD",
    `% of All Cases`   = "% of All Cases"
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_align("left", Diagnosis) %>%
  gt::cols_align("center",
    c(Numerator, `Denominator (IPD)`, `% of IPD`, `% of All Cases`)
  ) %>%

  # Formatting
  gt::fmt_number(columns = Numerator, decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `Denominator (IPD)`, decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(`% of IPD`, `% of All Cases`), decimals = 1) %>%
  gt::fmt_missing(gt::everything(), missing_text = "") %>%

  # Styling
  gt::opt_table_font(
    font = list(gt::google_font("Roboto"), gt::default_fonts())
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_align_table_header(align = "left") %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "black"),
    locations = gt::cells_body()
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_width(
    Diagnosis ~ gt::px(260),
    everything() ~ gt::px(130)
  )
```

```{r complications}
#| title: "Complications IPD"

# -------------------------
# PREP COMPLICATION MATRIX
# -------------------------
complications_ipd <- ipd %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::starts_with("complications_"),
    -dplyr::any_of("complications_none")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      everything(),
      ~ .x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true")
    )
  )

# -------------------------
# ANY COMPLICATION
# -------------------------
any_complication_n <- sum(
  rowSums(complications_ipd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
)

# -------------------------
# INDIVIDUAL COMPLICATIONS
# -------------------------
complication_prop <- complications_ipd %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "complication",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `% of IPD` = round(n / N_IPD * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    complication = stringr::str_remove(complication, "^complications_"),
    complication = stringr::str_replace_all(complication, "_", " "),
    complication = stringr::str_to_title(complication)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))

# -------------------------
# FINAL TABLE DATA
# -------------------------
complications_section <- tibble::tibble(
  `Complication Type` = c("Any complication", complication_prop$complication),

  `N (IPD)` = c(any_complication_n, complication_prop$n),

  Denominator = c(N_IPD, rep(N_IPD, nrow(complication_prop))),

  `% of IPD` = c(
    ifelse(N_IPD > 0, round(any_complication_n / N_IPD * 100, 2), NA),
    complication_prop$`% of IPD`
  )
)

# -------------------------
# GT TABLE
# -------------------------
complications_section %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**Complications (IPD Patients)**")
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_label(
    `Complication Type` = "Complication Type",
    `N (IPD)`           = "IPD (N)",
    Denominator         = "Total IPD",
    `% of IPD`          = "% of IPD"
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_align("left", `Complication Type`) %>%
  gt::cols_align("center", c(`N (IPD)`, Denominator, `% of IPD`)) %>%

  # Formatting
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(`N (IPD)`, Denominator), decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `% of IPD`, decimals = 1) %>%
  gt::fmt_missing(gt::everything(), missing_text = "") %>%

  # Styling
  gt::opt_table_font(
    font = list(gt::google_font("Roboto"), gt::default_fonts())
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_align_table_header(align = "left") %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "black"),
    locations = gt::cells_body()
  ) %>%

  # Highlight "Any complication"
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#F8F9FA")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      rows = `Complication Type` == "Any complication"
    )
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_width(
    `Complication Type` ~ gt::px(260),
    everything() ~ gt::px(130)
  )
```

```{r Epicurve large}
#| padding: 0px

# -------------------------
# EPI CURVE (TILE)
# -------------------------
epi_curve <- ggplot(
  epi_cases,
  aes(
    x = date_of_visit,
    y = case_id,
    fill = ipd_opd,
    text = hover_text
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 day",
    date_labels = "%d %b",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Epidemic curve – measles",
    subtitle = paste0(
      format(min(epi_cases$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE), "%d.%m"),
      " – ",
      format(max(epi_cases$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE), "%d.%m")
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cases",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

# -------------------------
# INTERACTIVE
# -------------------------
ggplotly(epi_curve, tooltip = "text") %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
